game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 9: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Imperative operations.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: loop_runs drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while loop_runs > 0.
source_player_objective: Protect the exit ledge from glow-eyed lurkers in Bat Hollow: keep the loop_runs meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
